title: Finland – Advertising and marketing services – Luova toimistokumppani Oulun yliopiston markkinoinnille, viestinnälle ja yhteiskuntasuhteille
description: Oulun yliopisto kilpailuttaa kumppania toteuttamaan viestinnän ja markkinoinnin palveluita luovana mainostoimistokumppanina. Hankinta koostuu erilaisista viestinnän ja markkinoinnin toimeksiannoista, jotka voivat olla joko laajoja kampanjakokonaisuuksia tai yksittäisiä luovia toimeksiantoja. Luova mainostoimistokumppani toimii Oulun yliopiston strategisena ja operatiivisena kumppanina tarjoten esimerkiksi kampanjoiden konseptointia ja luovaa suunnittelua, brändin sisällöllistä kehittämistä, markkinointi- ja viestintämateriaalien visuaalista ja sisällöllistä uudistamista, verkkosivujen tekstisuunnittelua ja copywritingia, sekä muuta strategista sparrausta ja luovaa asiantuntijatyötä. Hankinnan keskeisimpänä kokonaisuutena on korkeakoulujen yhteishakuihin liittyvän hakijamarkkinointikampanjan konseptointi, luova suunnittelu ja kehittäminen. Yksittäiset toimeksiannot voivat olla esimerkiksi hakijamarkkinoinnin sisältöjen suunnittelua, työnantajamielikuvakampanjoita, esittely- ja markkinointimateriaalien visuaalista ja sisällöllistä uudistamista, verkkosivujen tekstisuunnittelua ja copywritingia, brändin sisällöllistä kehittämistä sekä erilaisten luovien konseptien suunnittelua. Kilpailutus toteutetaan kaksivaiheisena (rajoitettu menettely). Tämä on kilpailutuksen ensimmäinen vaihe ja koskee osallistumishakemusten jättämistä. Osallistumishakemusten jättäneistä jatkoon valitaan enintään 5 tarjoajaa, joille lähetetään tarjouspyyntö. Kuvaus hankinnasta tarkemmin Liite 1 Palvelukuvaus

title: Finland – Building-cleaning services – Siivouspalvelut
description: Pyydämme tarjoustanne Tampereen Infra Oy:n tilojen siivouspalveluista tarjouspyynnön liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osa-alueisiin, sillä tavoitteena on löytää yksi sopimuskumppani tuottamaan kokonaisuudessaan tarvittavat siivouspalvelut minimoiden näin tilaajan hallinnolliset sopimusseurantatyöt tämän sopimuksen osalta. Myöskään osatarjoukset tai vaihtoehtoiset tarjoukset ole sallittuja. Kyseessä on EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä palveluhankinta, jonka ennakoitu arvo on noin 600 000 euroa sisältäen mahdolliset optiot. Siivousten kohteina ovat Tampereen Infra Oy:n kiinteät toimitilat, siirrettävät työmaasuojat ja tuntiperusteiset uimarantojen pukuhuonetilojen siivoukset. Toimitilat koostuvat pääosin tauko-, sosiaali- ja toimistotiloista ja palvelevat koko Tampereen Infra Oy:n henkilöstöä. Työmaasuojat ovat Tampereen Infra Oy:n työmaiden yhteyteen ympäri Tamperetta sijoitettavia noin 10–20 m2 kokoisia hinattavia taukovaunuja. Uimarantojen pukuhuonetilojen siivouspalvelu on tuntiperusteista siivousta, joka pääosin keskittyy kesäviikonloppuihin. Siivouskohteiden tarkemmat ominaisuudet ja muut tiedot löytyvät tarjouspyyntömateriaaleista. Ennen kilpailutusta hankinnasta lähetettiin julkaistavaksi markkinavuoropuheluilmoitus Hilma-palvelussa 22.9.2026. Markkinavuoropuhelun aikana 22.9.2026-2.10.2026 halukkaiden potentiaalisten tarjoajien oli mahdollista kommentoida tarjouspyyntöluonnosmateriaalia

title: Luxembourg – Technical assistance services – Climate Action and Sustainability for Corporate
description: The overall objective of this Assignment is to contribute to the EU sustainable finance policy objectives by strengthening the role of corporates in the transition to a low carbon, climate resilient and environmentally sustainable economy. Under the Advisory Programme to Support Climate Action and Sustainability for Corporates, the EIB will support selected Beneficiaries in developing Climate Alignment Plans (decarbonisation, resilience, mitigation and adaptation plans), and sustainability linked financing frameworks. The specific objective of this Assignment is for a Service Provider to support Beneficiaries to adjust and align their business models and investment projects to climate and environmental sustainability related regulatory and lending requirements. In particular, this involves advisory support related to Climate Alignment Plans, Sustainability Linked Loans and Transversal Tasks.

title: Finland – Support services for air transport – Maahuolintapalvelut
description: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (jäljempänä Hankintayksikkö) pyytää tarjoustanne Maahuolintapalvelut hankintaan Puolustusvoimille tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on ensisijaisesti ulkomailla tapahtuviin kriisinhallintatehtäviin lähetettävien tai sieltä saapuvien materiaalien sekä henkilöstön maahuolinta. Lisäksi hankinnan kohteena on Suomeen saapuvan ja lähtevän puolustusmateriaalin ja henkilöstön maahuolintaa millä tahansa hankinnan osa-alueen lentokentällä. Maahuolintapalveluilla tarkoitetaan lentokoneen laskeutumisen ja nousun välisenä aikana tehtäviä palveluita. Saapuvat tai lähetevät lentokoneet voivat olla matkustaja-, rahti- tai sotilaskoneita, joiden maahuolinnalle tulee antaa konetyyppikohtainen hinta (ks. liite 2). Lisäksi on erillishinnoiteltavia palveluita kuten esim. de-icing, toilet- ja vesipalvelu, jotka tulee pystyä tuottamaan tarvittaessa. Ilmarahti ja matkatavarat tulee purkaa tai lastata kyytiin ja matkustajille tulee pystyä tarjomaan palveluita. Tarvittavien palveluiden tarve ja volyymi vaihtelee kenttäkohtaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena oleva, Maahuolintapalvelut, hankinta on jaettu 2 eri osa-alueeseen lentokenttien mukaisesti: - Pori - Jyväskylä Osa-alueista tehdään kenttäkohtaiset sopimukset kahdeksi (2) vuodeksi osa-alueen voittaneen Tarjoajan kanssa. Kumpaakin Sopimusta on erikseen mahdollista jatkaa kahdella (2) kahden (2) vuoden optiokaudella.

title: France – Health insurance services – Prestation de Protection Sociale Complémentaire Santé d'Entreprise pour RTM Ouest Métropole.
description: La présente consultation vise la passation d'un marché public ayant pour objet des prestations de Protection Sociale Complémentaire santé dans le cadre d'un contrat groupe à adhésion obligatoire pour la formule « Standard », et facultative pour la formule « Confort », pour les salariés et les ayants droits de RTM Ouest Métropole. Le régime actuel couvre environ 144 salariés cotisant pour la formule standard, dont 38 salariés cotisant pour la formule confort, soit plus de 422 bénéficiaires comprenant environ 84 conjoints et 194 enfants. Le régime vise les salariés actifs sous contrat à durée indéterminée ou sous contrat à durée déterminée.

description: Salon kaupunki (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö / tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia Tupurin koulun ja päiväkodin peruskorjauksen hankinnasta kokonaisurakkana tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteenä olevien urakka-asiakirjojen ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on osoitteessa Taimistokatu 1 sijaitseva peruskorjattava Tupurin koulu ja päiväkoti. Urakkamuotona on kokonaisurakka. Urakkasuoritukseen sisältyvät kaikki kohteen suunnitelma-asiakirjoissa esitetyt työt, materiaalit, hankinnat ja velvoitteet, ellei suunnitelmissa muuta mainita. Urakoitsijan tulee huomioida tarjouksessaan, että urakka toteutetaan kolmevaiheisena ja urakan aikana koulu ja päiväkoti toimivat rakennuksessa ja pihapiirissä. Urakoitsijan tulee huomioida urakan luonteesta johtuvasta yhteensovittamisesta, sekä vaiheistamisesta ja koulun toiminnan turvaamisesta urakkaan aiheutuvat kustannukset. title: Q301--FY27 (BASE+4) STAT Laboratory Testing - Syracuse (VA-27-00010334)
description: Special Notice of Intent to Sole Source This is a SPECIAL NOTICE ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. The Department of Veteran Affairs, VISN 2 Network Contracting Office intends to award a sole source contract for the Syracuse VA Medical Center within the Upstate NY Healthcare Network shown below. This proposed contract action is for a service in which the Government intends to award a firm fixed-price contract with only one source for a Base Period plus four (4) Option Periods to University Pathologists Laboratories, 750 East Adams Street, Syracuse, New York 13202-2306 under the authority Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 6.302-1(a)(2), only one responsible source. Places of Performance: Department of Veterans Affairs VISN 2 VA Medical Centers Syracuse VAMC 800 Irving Avenue Syracuse, NY 13210-1276 Purpose and Objectives: The intent of this Special Notice is to identify potential offerors capable of providing analysis, monitoring, and reporting findings of laboratory and pathology tests for the VA Upstate NY Healthcare System at Syracuse VAMC. Contractor shall provide STAT laboratory testing on Veteran patient specimens seven days a week, including holidays, 24 hours a day. Contractor laboratory requires mandatory licensing and accreditation possessing a NYS Department of Health Clinical Laboratory Permit, Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) License and College of American Pathologists (CAP) Accreditation. General Requirements The contractor must comply with the following general requirements: Contractor shall utilize board certified pathologists and accredited technologists to perform services for this contract. The Contractor shall hold the following certifications and provide documentation of the same with the proposed quote: NYS Department of Health Clinical Laboratory Permit CLIA License CAP Accreditation and/or Joint Commission Contractor shall provide services to include sample pick-up, transport, processing, analysis and diagnostic reporting of surgical and clinical specimens. 1. The Contractor must pick up specimen within 30 minutes of the request for service. Contractor shall perform specimen processing and diagnosis utilizing electron microscopy, immunofluorescence, immuno-histochemical, molecular, genetic and any state of the art studies as needed for a STAT diagnosis. Contractor must complete testing and call the VA with results, faxing completed written reports to Syracuse VA Medical Center within 5 working days. The Contractor testing services shall be available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year (including holidays). Contractor shall provide requisition forms pre-printed with Syracuse VA Medical Center client information for processing and billing purposes. Upon the request of an authorized VA employee, Contractor shall call back the results of critical tests by telephone as soon as results are known. The information shall be documented in the follow-up printed report including the date and time of the call, and the identification of the caller and recipient of the call. 1. Critical results require immediate notification to an authorized provider or staff member to facilitate prompt patient intervention. Contractor shall provide Syracuse VAMC telephone number(s) and contact person(s) available to the VA for specimen problem inquiries, problem solving and status of pending tests at all times including weekends and holidays. Response: Responses to this Special Notice should be able to demonstrate the firm's ability, capability, and responsibility to deliver the service listed above. The purpose of this Special Notice announcement is for market research to make appropriate acquisition decisions and to gain knowledge of potential qualified Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses, Veteran Owned Small Businesses, 8(a), HubZone and other Small Businesses interested and capable of providing the services described above. Documentation of technical expertise must be presented in sufficient detail for the Government to determine that your company possesses the necessary functional area expertise and experience to compete for this acquisition. No funds have been authorized, appropriated, or received for this effort. Responses should include the following information: Business name, address, business size and Socioeconomic Category (HUBZone, 8(a), Service Disabled Veteran, Small Business, Large Business, etc.), and point of contact to include e-mail address and telephone number. All offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (www.sam.gov) and Representations and Certifications must be completed prior to any future award. Supporting evidence must be furnished in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to provide the STAT specimen analysis, monitoring, and reporting findings of laboratory and pathology tests as noted above. Determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Important information: The Government is not obligated to, nor will it pay for or reimburse any costs associated with responding to this sources sought synopsis request. title: Available for Licensing: Fluorescent Tracer Technology for Hydrofluoric Acid Exposure Detection
description: Technology Licensing Opportunity: This technology is available for licensing through Idaho National Laboratory's (INL) Technology Deployment office. INL is not seeking to procure products or services in connection with this technology, and no procurement activity is associated with INL's technology transfer process. Interested parties are invited to contact INL to discuss licensing terms and partnership opportunities. Overview Hydrofluoric acid (HF) is used across petroleum refining, semiconductor manufacturing, glass processing, pharmaceutical synthesis, mineral processing, and laboratory research, among others. Despite established handling protocols, accidental skin or surface contact remains a persistent hazard � compounded by HF's unusual toxicological profile: at low concentrations, early-stage contact produces no pain, burning, or visible irritation, while damage to subcutaneous tissue and bone progresses silently before symptoms appear. This technology introduces a UV-fluorescent tracer additive created froma xanthene powder.. The additive is designed to remain chemically inert while enabling workers to survey skin, clothing, or surfaces using a UV light source after handling. Fluorescence indicates contact, supporting immediate decontamination and first aid before acid penetrates tissue. The approach is intended as a complementary detection layer alongside existing personal protective equipment and engineering controls. Industry Need Current HF safety practice relies on prevention: chemical-resistant PPE, engineered containment, and procedural controls. These measures reduce exposure frequency but do not eliminate the risk of accidental contact, particularly in production environments or during equipment maintenance. No field-deployable method currently exists for workers to confirm the absence of skin or surface contact after an HF-handling task. The standard indicator of exposure is symptom onset, which may occur hours after contact, after significant physiological damage has already occurred. This detection gap represents a structural limitation in current HF safety frameworks across all affected industries. Differentiation and Advantages Post-task detection capability: Designed to enable active worker self-survey after HF handling, a capability not provided by current commercial safety approaches. Chemically inert tracer formulation: Xanthene dye has documented chemical stability in HF environments and is not expected to alter acid reactivity, concentration, or intended function. Early-window treatment support: Detection prior to symptom onset is intended to expand the effective window for decontamination and calcium gluconate application, both of which are more effective when administered early. Leak detection in system processes: Secondarily, this product improves leak detection in industrial processes by creating a high visibility and distinct HF appearance that can reduce detection time and differentiate HF from other clear fluids used in the process. Potential Applications Industrial HF handling operations in petroleum refining, semiconductor etch, glass manufacturing, and pharmaceutical synthesis. Worker post-task self-survey using portable UV light sources following HF-handling tasks. Facility leak and spill detection through UV scanning of work surfaces and equipment exteriors. Laboratory and small-scale research environments where engineering controls may be less robust.

title: Q301--FY27 (BASE+4) STAT Laboratory Testing - Syracuse (VA-27-00010334)
description: Special Notice of Intent to Sole Source This is a SPECIAL NOTICE ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. The Department of Veteran Affairs, VISN 2 Network Contracting Office intends to award a sole source contract for the Syracuse VA Medical Center within the Upstate NY Healthcare Network shown below. This proposed contract action is for a service in which the Government intends to award a firm fixed-price contract with only one source for a Base Period plus four (4) Option Periods to University Pathologists Laboratories, 750 East Adams Street, Syracuse, New York 13202-2306 under the authority Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 6.302-1(a)(2), only one responsible source. Places of Performance: Department of Veterans Affairs VISN 2 VA Medical Centers Syracuse VAMC 800 Irving Avenue Syracuse, NY 13210-1276 Purpose and Objectives: The intent of this Special Notice is to identify potential offerors capable of providing analysis, monitoring, and reporting findings of laboratory and pathology tests for the VA Upstate NY Healthcare System at Syracuse VAMC. Contractor shall provide STAT laboratory testing on Veteran patient specimens seven days a week, including holidays, 24 hours a day. Contractor laboratory requires mandatory licensing and accreditation possessing a NYS Department of Health Clinical Laboratory Permit, Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) License and College of American Pathologists (CAP) Accreditation. General Requirements The contractor must comply with the following general requirements: Contractor shall utilize board certified pathologists and accredited technologists to perform services for this contract. The Contractor shall hold the following certifications and provide documentation of the same with the proposed quote: NYS Department of Health Clinical Laboratory Permit CLIA License CAP Accreditation and/or Joint Commission Contractor shall provide services to include sample pick-up, transport, processing, analysis and diagnostic reporting of surgical and clinical specimens. 1. The Contractor must pick up specimen within 30 minutes of the request for service. Contractor shall perform specimen processing and diagnosis utilizing electron microscopy, immunofluorescence, immuno-histochemical, molecular, genetic and any state of the art studies as needed for a STAT diagnosis. Contractor must complete testing and call the VA with results, faxing completed written reports to Syracuse VA Medical Center within 5 working days. The Contractor testing services shall be available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year (including holidays). Contractor shall provide requisition forms pre-printed with Syracuse VA Medical Center client information for processing and billing purposes. Upon the request of an authorized VA employee, Contractor shall call back the results of critical tests by telephone as soon as results are known. The information shall be documented in the follow-up printed report including the date and time of the call, and the identification of the caller and recipient of the call. 1. Critical results require immediate notification to an authorized provider or staff member to facilitate prompt patient intervention. Contractor shall provide Syracuse VAMC telephone number(s) and contact person(s) available to the VA for specimen problem inquiries, problem solving and status of pending tests at all times including weekends and holidays. Response: Responses to this Special Notice should be able to demonstrate the firm's ability, capability, and responsibility to deliver the service listed above. The purpose of this Special Notice announcement is for market research to make appropriate acquisition decisions and to gain knowledge of potential qualified Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses, Veteran Owned Small Businesses, 8(a), HubZone and other Small Businesses interested and capable of providing the services described above. Documentation of technical expertise must be presented in sufficient detail for the Government to determine that your company possesses the necessary functional area expertise and experience to compete for this acquisition. No funds have been authorized, appropriated, or received for this effort. Responses should include the following information: Business name, address, business size and Socioeconomic Category (HUBZone, 8(a), Service Disabled Veteran, Small Business, Large Business, etc.), and point of contact to include e-mail address and telephone number. All offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (www.sam.gov) and Representations and Certifications must be completed prior to any future award. Supporting evidence must be furnished in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to provide the STAT specimen analysis, monitoring, and reporting findings of laboratory and pathology tests as noted above. Determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Important information: The Government is not obligated to, nor will it pay for or reimburse any costs associated with responding to this sources sought synopsis request. This notice shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or ultimately award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. The Government will in no way be bound to this information if any solicitation is issued. No sub-contracting opportunity is anticipated. The North American Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 621511 ($41.5 Million). Any offeror capable of providing this service shall notify the Contracting Officer by email within 10 calendar days from the date of the publication of this Special Notice. All information is to be submitted via e-mail to: Michelle.Harsch@va.gov

title: France – Filtering apparatus – Marché public global de performance pour la fourniture, la mise en service, l'exploitation et la maintenance de systèmes d'épuration d'air dans des stations de métro de Lyon
description: &gt;_Dans le cadre de son engagement pour améliorer la qualité de l'air de son réseau souterrain, SYTRAL Mobilités a décidé d'équiper les stations de métro Grange Blanche, Bellecour lignes A et D avec des systèmes d'épuration d'air par piégeage des particules fines. L'objectif est d'épurer l'air aux endroits de stationnement des voyageurs donc les quais de station. Dans ce cadre, il est prévu d'avoir recours à un marché public global de performance pour l'exécution des prestations associées au sens des articles L2171-3, R2171-2 et R2172-3 du code de la commande publique. Cette typologie de marché se justifie par la nécessité de garantir, sur la durée, l'atteinte d'objectifs mesurables de réduction de la concentration en particules fines dans les stations de métro. Les performances attendues dépendent à la fois de la qualité des équipements proposés, de leur implantation, de leur réglage, de leur exploitation et de leur maintenance. La responsabilité unique du Titulaire permet ainsi de garantir l'atteinte des objectifs de performance fixés contractuellement Les caractéristiques principales du besoin sont la fourniture des équipements, les études d'implantation (réseaux et modification ERP), l'installation, la mise en service, l'exploitation et la maintenance de systèmes d'épuration d'air dans les quais des stations de métro des lignes A et D de Bellecour ainsi que ceux de la station de Grange Blanche. L'exploitation et la maintenance des équipements sont prévues pour une durée maximale de 5 ans (dont 3 ans ferme). La rémunération du titulaire au titre de l'exploitation et de la maintenance des équipements tiendra compte des objectifs de performance conformément aux dispositions de l'article R2171-3 du code de la commande publique. La rémunération de l'opérateur économique sera donc modulée en cas de sous-performance ou de sur-performance &gt;_Le marché est décomposé en une tranche ferme et 2 tranches optionnelles au sens des articles R2113-4 à R2113-6 du code de la commande publique &gt;_L'acheteur se réserve la possibilité d'attribuer le marché sur la base des offres initiales sans négociation

title: Helicopter Services for Idaho
description: This is a sources sought notice ONLY. Quotes are not to be submitted nor will they be accepted at this time for this requirement. The government is seeking interested vendors that are in the site areas listed below, or vendors that are able to provide the below services in the site areas listed below. All snow survey measurements are to be in accordance with the snow measurement sampling guide, Agriculture Handbook Number 169. Erroneous measurements and wide variations in density indicating inaccurate sampling cannot be accepted or reimbursed. Schedule of Snow Courses to be Completed: Site Name Jan-1 Feb-1 Mar-1 Apr-1 Camp Creek X X X X Kilgore X X X X Irving Creek X X Webber Creek X X Measurements are to be taken as near to the first of each month as possible. Scheduled Date Acceptable Window 1-Jan Dec 27 - Jan 1 1-Feb Jan 27 - Feb 1 1-Mar Feb 24 - Mar 1 1-Apr Mar 27 - Apr 1 1-May Apr 26 - May 1 1-Jun May 27 - Jun 1 Measurements taken outside the specified dates will not be accepted or reimbursed unless approved by the Boise Snow Survey Office prior to making the measurements. All government-provided equipment, including the snow sampling set, must be returned to the nearest NRCS Field or State Office when measurements are completed before payment can be processed. To meet publication deadlines, snow measurement data may be provided by phone, fax, or preferably email if original notes cannot reach the Boise Snow Survey Office by the SECOND DAY OF EACH MONTH. Upon completion of the snow survey measurements, submit an invoice online via www.IPP.gov. Additional details will be provided in the contract documents. NRCS Snow Survey maintains an extensive automated (SNOTEL) and manual (Snow Course) data collection network in the Western United States and Alaska. Combined, the network encompasses nearly 2,000 remote snow measurement sites in mountain snowpack zones. Congress mandated NRCS (then the Soil Conservation Service) in the mid 1930's "to measure snowpack in the mountains of the West and forecast the water supply." NRCS Snow Survey now provides reliable and efficiently collected data needed to produce water supply forecasts and to support resource management activities across the Western US. The high-elevation watershed locations, broad coverage, and real-time operation of the network provide important data to farmers, researchers, river and reservoir managers, emergency managers for natural disasters such as floods and droughts, and for power generation. In some remote locations, private local contractors have been utilized to conduct critical manual snow measurements. The contractors have the wherewithal (over-snow travel equipment, snow samplers) and knowledge of local terrain to complete work in a timely manner. Additionally, local surveyors have many years of experience using a federal snow sampler, calculating snow-water-equivalent, and communicating results to the main NRCS Snow Survey office. These surveyors are unique in terms of the combination of location, equipment, and willingness. Lastly, data continuity between years is key to making NRCS Snow Data most useful and to decrease data uncertainty (error). Year-to-year data continuity is best achieved by utilizing the same surveyors as long as possible.

title: Defense Logistics Agency - Troop Support � Europe & Africa Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Contract for Laboratory Reagents, Test Kits, and Consumables
description: DLA � TS E&A, in conjunction with the United States Army Medical Materiel Center-Europe (USAMMCE), is conducting market research to support the recompete of its commercial laboratory supplies contract. The resulting contract will provide clinical laboratory reagents, test cartridges, calibrators, controls, and associated consumables that operate in conjunction with specific Government-owned laboratory analyzers and capital equipment (e.g., Abbott i-STAT, Siemens DCA 2000, and other point-of-care or automated platforms). The primary ordering activity and logistics hub is USAMMCE, servicing Department of Defense (DoD) medical treatment facilities and operational forces across the European Command (EUCOM) and possibly Central Command (CENTCOM) theaters. The follow-on ordering period is projected to commence on 15 January 2028.
